caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object consisting of a dark, spherical central element with a cylindrical rod extending horizontally through its center. This sphere and rod assembly is mounted on a shallow, elongated, boat-shaped base with pointed ends and angled supports beneath. The object is rendered in grayscale tones, giving it a metallic appearance. Above the main perspective view, there are additional schematic line drawings: a top view, a side view, a circular end view, and a cross-sectional view of the assembly, as well as a small linear measurement scale marked from 0 to 6. The drawing is set inside a rectangular border on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Coffee Grinder
